Our Services

Pest control that keeps your property pest-free

Our Five Star Pest Control Program uses extensive perimeter treatments — applied without you being home — while our Turf Magic program keeps your lawn lush and weed-free.

Five Star Pest Control

Our most popular program: two lines of perimeter defense that stop pests from entering — no need to spray inside constantly. Family and pet safe.

Termite Control

Expert detection and treatment for subterranean and drywood termites before they eat through your home's structure.

Mosquito Control

Take back your yard with treatments that target mosquitoes where they breed and rest — so you can enjoy Florida outdoors again.

Rodent Control

Rats and mice removed and entry points sealed, so they can't come back. Thorough inspection included.

Turf Magic Lawn Care

Monthly fertilization and weed control that exceeds other lawn spray programs — lush green grass, ugly weeds gone.

Commercial Pest Control

Discreet, reliable pest management for Tampa Bay businesses with a convenient online pay portal.
